source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The read dialog matches organizer and attendee IDs case-insensitively. It replaces a matching displayed attendee with a clone marked as organizer, or adds an organizer clone with no participation status. This preserves an existing attendee status and lets the row show an organizer label without a spurious status icon. The added test checks deduplication and that a stored attendee is not marked as organizer; it does not prove every event field or runtime accessibility.
title: Calendar read-dialog organizer rows use display clones
